title: Point Blank: Minigun Motor Recipe - Craft the Minigun
description: Craft the Minigun Motor instead of trading for it, so you can build Point Blank's M134 Minigun in survival without hunting down an Arms Dealer.
body:
The Minigun Motor normally only comes from trading with an Arms Dealer, so you need to find one, level them up and hope for the trade. This pack adds a crafting recipe, so you can build your Minigun whenever you've gathered the materials.

**Requires [Vic's Point Blank](https://modrinth.com/mod/vics-point-blank)**

## Recipe
![Minigun Motor recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1831461b08e87a70bf569fd70c816f5b7e2acba3.png)

Uses Point Blank's own late-game materials, so the Minigun still feels earned.

## Features
- Craft the Minigun Motor in a crafting table
- No Arms Dealer trading needed
- Balanced: uses late-game Point Blank materials
- Lightweight: only adds one recipe, nothing else changes
- Works on servers and in singleplayer

## Installation
- **Datapack:** put the .zip in your world's `datapacks` folder
- **Mod version:** put the .jar in your `mods` folder (Fabric, Quilt, Forge, NeoForge)

## Modpacks
You're welcome to use this in any modpack, no need to ask! A link back to this page is appreciated.

title: Point Blank: Loot - Guns in Structure Chests
description: Find Point Blank guns, ammo and attachments in dungeons, outposts, temples, bastions and End cities. Better loot in more dangerous structures. Also fills the empty Arms Dealer Barn chest.
body:
Exploring finally pays off for gun players. **Point Blank: Loot** adds ammo, gun parts, attachments and weapons from [Vic's Point Blank](https://modrinth.com/mod/vics-point-blank) to chests all over the world, from early-game dungeons to End city treasure.

All vanilla loot is kept. Point Blank items are added on top, never instead.

Works on **Fabric, Quilt, Forge and NeoForge**, or as a plain datapack, on every Point Blank version from 1.20.1 to 26.1.2.

**Requires [Vic's Point Blank](https://modrinth.com/mod/vics-point-blank)**

## What you'll find

| Where | Loot |
|---|---|
| Dungeons, mineshafts, shipwrecks | Ammo, gunmetal and parts, rare pistols |
| Weaponsmith and pillager outposts | Ammo, pistols, attachments, SMGs and rifles |
| Desert & jungle temples, strongholds | Attachments, rare ammo, pistols, SMGs, rifles, shotguns |
| Bastions, woodland mansions, ancient cities | Rare ammo, rifles, sniper rifles, machine guns |
| End city treasure | Very rare heavy weapons: minigun, rocket launchers, grenade launcher |

The deeper and more dangerous the structure, the better the guns.

## Arms Dealer Barn fix
The Arms Dealer Barn chest used to hold a single Glock and farm food. Now it's a proper arms cache: always ammo, often a pistol, plus parts, attachments and the occasional SMG or rifle.

> The barn fix needs **Point Blank 2.0 or newer**. On older versions the barn chest has no loot table, so no pack can fill it. Everything else works on all supported versions.

## Features
- Point Blank loot in 13 vanilla structures
- Balanced by structure difficulty, so you won't find a minigun in your first dungeon
- Keeps all vanilla loot
- Update-safe: if Point Blank renames an item, only that item stops dropping, nothing breaks
- Works on servers and in singleplayer

## Installation
- **Datapack:** put the .zip in your world's `datapacks` folder (one file works on every supported version)
- **Mod version:** put the .jar in your `mods` folder (Fabric, Quilt, Forge, NeoForge). Fabric/Quilt also need Fabric API.

Loot only appears in chests that haven't been opened yet, so explore new chunks or structures you haven't looted.

## Compatibility
Mods that add loot through code work fine alongside it. Another **datapack** that replaces the same vanilla chest loot tables may override this one (or the other way around).

title: TACZ: Loot - Guns in Structure Chests
description: Find TACZ guns, ammo and attachments in dungeons, outposts, temples, bastions, ancient cities and End cities. Better loot in more dangerous structures. Keeps all vanilla loot.
body:
Exploring finally pays off for gun players. **TACZ: Loot** adds guns, ammo and attachments from [Timeless and Classics Zero (TACZ)](https://modrinth.com/mod/timeless-and-classics-zero) to chests all over the world, from early-game dungeons to End city treasure.

All vanilla loot is kept. TACZ items are added on top, never instead.

**Requires [TACZ](https://modrinth.com/mod/timeless-and-classics-zero) 1.2.0 or newer** (Forge 1.20.1 or NeoForge 1.21.1)

## What you'll find

| Where | Loot |
|---|---|
| Dungeons, mineshafts, shipwreck supplies, ruined portals, buried treasure | Pistol ammo, basic sights and lasers, rare pistols |
| Weaponsmiths, pillager outposts, Nether fortresses, shipwreck treasure | Pistols, SMGs, early rifles and shotguns, grips and red dots |
| Desert & jungle temples, strongholds | SMGs, shotguns, assault rifles, DMRs, bolt-action rifles, 2–4x scopes, suppressors |
| Bastions, woodland mansions, ancient cities, trial chamber vaults (1.21.1) | Battle rifles, sniper rifles, machine guns, high-power scopes, extended mags |
| End city treasure | Very rare heavy weapons: minigun, RPG-7, M320, M107, golden Deagle |

The deeper and more dangerous the structure, the better the guns. Ammo matches the guns you can find in each tier, and every gun spawns in a fire mode it actually supports.

## Features
- TACZ guns, ammo and attachments in 23 vanilla structure loot tables
- Balanced by structure difficulty, so you won't find a minigun in your first dungeon
- Keeps all vanilla loot
- Uses TACZ's own loot injection system, so it **doesn't replace any loot tables** and works alongside other loot data packs
- Works on servers and in singleplayer

## Installation
- **Data pack:** put the .zip in your world's `datapacks` folder
- **Mod version:** put the .jar in your `mods` folder (Forge 1.20.1 or NeoForge 1.21.1)

Loot only appears in chests that haven't been opened yet, so explore new chunks or structures you haven't looted.

title: Smooch: Kiss Other Players (Vanilla Edition)
description: Crouch while looking at another player to kiss them: heart particles, a kiss sound and good effects for both of you. Configurable cooldown and effects. Kiss, hug, couple, love, romance.
body:
Give the people you love a little smooch. Crouch while looking at another player's face and you kiss: hearts float between you and you both get a burst of good effects.

This is the **Vanilla Edition**. It works with nothing else installed, uses Minecraft's own sounds, and runs as a data pack or as a mod.

## How it works
Stand within 3 blocks of another player, look at their head and crouch. Hearts pop every time you crouch and keep floating while you hold it.

Both of you get 20 seconds of Regeneration, Absorption, Resistance, Strength, Speed, Haste, Jump Boost, Health Boost, Fire Resistance, Water Breathing, Night Vision, Luck, Slow Falling and Hero of the Village, plus a second of Saturation. Hearts never have a cooldown, but the effects do (5 minutes by default) so nobody can farm them.

## Settings
Run `/function smooch:config` to see every setting and what it's set to. You can:
- turn the cooldown on or off, change its length, and pick **per player** or **per pair** (per pair means kissing someone new still gives effects)
- switch any effect on or off and set each one's duration and level
- change the reach distance, hearts on tap / while holding, and sounds

`/function smooch:settings/reset` puts everything back to default and `/function smooch:uninstall` removes it cleanly.

## Which Smooch should I get?
| | Vanilla Edition | Sounds | [Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/smooch) | Animated |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kiss by crouching | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Hearts and good effects | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Real kiss and sparkle sounds | – | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Kiss with a keybind | – | – | ✓ | ✓ |
| Settings menu (Mod Menu / Mods list) | – | – | ✓ | ✓ |
| Kiss animation | – | – | – | ✓ |
| Needs on the client | Nothing | Resource pack | The mod | The mod + Player Animator |

- **Vanilla Edition** (this one): servers and realms where players shouldn't need to download anything.
- **Smooch: Sounds**: (coming soon)same thing with real kiss sounds, through a small resource pack.
- **[Smooch: Kiss Other Players](https://modrinth.com/mod/smooch)** (mod): a key to kiss and an in-game settings screen.
- **Smooch Animated** (mod, coming soon): the full version, where both players lean in for an actual kiss animation.

Only install one of them.

## Installation
Data pack: drop the .zip into your world's `datapacks` folder. Mod: drop the .jar into `mods` (Fabric, Quilt, Forge or NeoForge). Works in singleplayer and on servers, Minecraft 1.14 to 26.3. On 1.20.1 and older, effect durations snap to the nearest preset (the config screen lists them).

title: Anti Creeper Grief: No Creeper Block Damage
description: Creepers still explode and hurt you, but never destroy blocks. Stops creeper griefing and protects your builds without turning off mobGriefing for every mob.
body:
Creepers still explode, still hurt you, and are still a threat, but they can't destroy your builds anymore. Your bases, farms, storage rooms and redstone stay safe from that one creeper you didn't hear coming.

## Why not just use /gamerule mobGriefing?
Turning off `mobGriefing` also breaks other vanilla mechanics: villagers stop farming, endermen stop picking up blocks, and more. This pack **only affects creepers**, so everything else works exactly like vanilla.

## Features
- Creeper explosions don't break blocks
- Creepers still deal damage, so survival stays challenging
- Only creepers are affected, all other mobs work normally
- Lightweight: no config needed, works the moment you install it
- Works on servers and in singleplayer

## Perfect for
- Survival worlds and hardcore runs
- Multiplayer servers where you can't watch every build
- Long-term projects and big redstone builds

## Installation
- **Datapack:** put the .zip in your world's `datapacks` folder
- **Mod version:** put the .jar in your `mods` folder

title: Smooch: Sounds - Kiss Other Players
description: Crouch while looking at another player to give them a kiss, with real kiss sounds, sparkles, floating hearts and good effects for you both. Works for couples, friends and roleplay servers.
body:
Smooch with sound. Look at another player, crouch, and you'll hear a proper kiss: a soft smack, a little sparkle as the hearts appear, and a magical chime when the effects kick in.

Everything else works just like the [Vanilla Edition](https://modrinth.com/datapack/smooch-vanilla). This edition adds a small resource pack with 11 real recorded sounds.

## What happens when you kiss
- You need to be within 3 blocks, looking at the other player's head, and crouching
- Hearts float between you every time you crouch, and keep coming while you hold it
- You both get 20 seconds of good effects: Regeneration, Absorption, Resistance, Strength, Speed, Haste, Jump Boost, Health Boost, Fire Resistance, Water Breathing, Night Vision, Luck, Slow Falling, Hero of the Village and a short Saturation
- The effects have a 5-minute cooldown by default, the hearts and sounds don't

## Sounds
Four different kisses, four sparkles and three effect chimes, picked at random so it doesn't get repetitive. All of them are real recordings and have subtitles. You can switch them off with `/function smooch:settings/sound_off`.

## Settings
`/function smooch:config` shows every option. Cooldown on/off, its length, per player or per pair, every effect on/off with its own duration and level, reach distance, and when hearts appear. `/function smooch:settings/reset` goes back to default.

## Which Smooch should I get?
| | Vanilla Edition | Sounds | [Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/smooch) | Animated |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kiss by crouching | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Hearts and good effects | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Real kiss and sparkle sounds | – | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Kiss with a keybind | – | – | ✓ | ✓ |
| Settings menu (Mod Menu / Mods list) | – | – | ✓ | ✓ |
| Kiss animation | – | – | – | ✓ |
| Players need | Nothing | Resource pack | The mod | The mod + Player Animator |

Pick **Sounds** (this one) if you want the real kiss sounds but don't want to install a mod. Servers can push the resource pack to everyone automatically, so players don't have to do anything. If nobody should download anything at all, take the [Vanilla Edition](https://modrinth.com/datapack/smooch-vanilla). Prefer a key to kiss and a settings menu? Get the [Smooch mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/smooch). Smooch Animated is coming soon. Only install one edition.

## Installation
1. Put the data pack .zip in your world's `datapacks` folder (or use the mod .jar in `mods`)
2. Install the **resource pack** from the same version, it's the second file. On a server, set it as `resource-pack` in server.properties

Minecraft 1.14 to 26.3, singleplayer and servers. On 1.20.1 and older, effect durations snap to the nearest preset (the config screen lists them).

## Credits
Sounds are CC0 recordings from Freesound.org by gflower, davidou, semccab, LaurenPonder, newlocknew, 1urker, Alexia205, SkySpeira, adh.dreaming and Qvantor. Full list in CREDITS.txt inside the resource pack.
